info.name: Pioneer XDJ-AN
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ mapping for the XDJ-AN all-in-one in PC control (MIDI) mode: two decks, the mixer, Beat FX, hot cue, pad FX, beat jump and sampler pads. Beta: written from the XDJ-AN's MIDI messages as rekordbox maps them, not yet tried on the hardware.
